name: 60301 · Oak Park, IL
findings: ZIP 60301 (Oak Park) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (10% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60301 (Oak Park) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60301 (Oak Park) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
